_comment: High-severity MobSF findings reviewed and accepted for the release APK (release security gate, S4b-SEC-1; docs/06 TC-S-06). Matched on section and title. Each entry says who accepted it, when and why. A new High finding fails android.yml's mobsf job until it is fixed or reviewed here.

accepted.title: Missing Code Signing certificate
accepted.why: CI scans the unsigned release build on every push (no signing secrets outside main). The signed release APK is built and its signature verified with apksigner by android.yml's release job (TC-S-15).

accepted.title: Domain config is insecurely configured to permit clear text traffic to these domains in scope
accepted.why: Cleartext only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and 10.0.2.2 (the emulator's alias for the development machine), matching ServerUrl.LOCAL_HOSTS: a developer's local server. Every other host is HTTPS only and only system CAs are trusted (threat model F-02, SEC-004; res/xml/network_security_config.xml).
